The rockslide persists. It's a blocking object that can't be removed with my tools. Let me reconsider — maybe the pathfinding is being overly strict. The rock is at (11,4), and the gap is at (11,3). To reach (11,3) I'd need to come from (11,2) above, but that's only reachable through the gap. So the rock truly seals the corridor.

Wait — let me re-examine. The wall at y=3 spans x=0..10, with gap at x=11. Below the wall (y=4) is open except rock at (11,4). So from the south, to get to (11,3) I must pass through (11,4) which is blocked. Unless... let me check if the rock is actually at (11,4) or if I can approach (11,3) from (10,3)? No, (10,3) is wall.

Let me try walking to (11,3) directly to confirm it's unreachable, and also try the NoClip cheat isn't available. Let me verify the rock truly blocks by attempting adjacent walk to (11,3).
